messages.en:
{07 0c 00}Hey,{01 00 00 05 00} do you know how the
{ff 00 00 03}Flea Market{ff 00 00 00} works?{02 00 00 03 04}
Nope!
Oh, yeah!
messages.et:
{07 0c 00}Hei,{01 00 00 05 00} kas sa tead, kuidas
{ff 00 00 03}kirbuturg{ff 00 00 00} toimib?{02 00 00 03 04}
Ei!
Oo, jaa!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}This {ff 00 00 03}Flea Market{ff 00 00 00} specializes
in items for the home...

{07 14 00}You go into each other's
houses and make deals for
pieces that you want.
{07 00 00}So{01 00 00 05 00} what I'm saying{01 00 00 05 00} is,{01 01 00}
{07 19 00}you should be nice to
pushovers with good taste!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}See {ff 00 00 03}kirbuturg{ff 00 00 00} on
kodukaupade päralt...

{07 14 00}Te lähete üksteise
majja ja teete tehinguid
esemete üle, mida tahate.
{07 00 00}Nii et{01 00 00 05 00} ma tahan öelda{01 00 00 05 00},{01 01 00}
{07 19 00}et ole kena hea maitsega
lollikestega!

messages.en:
{07 19 00}Tee hee! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00}I can tell from
your great style that you
and I have similar taste.
{07 0d 00}So, as the {ff 00 00 03}Flea Market
{ff 00 00 00}approaches, let's chat!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Hihii! {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 14 00}Su suurepärasest
stiilist on näha, et meil
on sarnane maitse.
{07 0d 00}Nii et kui {ff 00 00 03}kirbuturg
{ff 00 00 00}läheneb, räägime!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}It's fine and good to choose
a series or furniture of
the same color,
{07 14 00}but I'd rather choose
individual pieces that I like
and coordinate them myself.
{07 19 00}My eye for style is keen
enough that I can pull it
off, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}On tore valida sari või
sama värvi mööbel,

{07 14 00}aga mina valin pigem
üksikud meeldivad esemed
ja sobitan need ise.
{07 19 00}Mu stiilisilm on nii terav,
et ma saan sellega
hakkama, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}If you're walking around
with a rare item,{01 00 00 0a 00} you might
meet someone special.
{07 15 00}And then they'll feed you
some dumb line like...

"{ff 00 00 02}Wanna trade my
{04 15 00} for your
heart?{ff 00 00 00}" {01 00 00 0a 00}Hmph!{07 00 00}
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui sa kõnnid ringi
haruldase esemega,{01 00 00 0a 00} võid
kohata kedagi erilist.
{07 15 00}Ja siis söödab ta sulle
mõne rumala lause nagu...

„{ff 00 00 02}Kas vahetad mu
{04 15 00} oma
südame vastu?{ff 00 00 00}” {01 00 00 0a 00}Hmph!{07 00 00}

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}It can be hard to find{01 00 00 0a 00}
really good furniture.

{07 19 00}You have to be diligent,
do the legwork, and{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}gather information yourself!
{07 1b 00}In other words,{01 00 00 05 00} it's kinda
like dating, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}Tõeliselt head mööblit{01 00 00 0a 00}
võib olla raske leida.

{07 19 00}Pead olema hoolas,
jalgu kulutama ja{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}ise infot koguma!
{07 1b 00}Teisisõnu,{01 00 00 05 00} see on natuke
nagu käimine, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
